block.guhs.guhwinter_kerstlampjes.lore: A string of twinkling lights for your wall. Melts on 3 January, like the snow.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.bezig: You're still busy with another game, vadsje.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.bord.eigen.ge: You haven't played the Pepernoten Race yet. The cabinet is right next to it!
You haven't skated a lap yet. The start sign is by the pond!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.bord.leeg: Nobody yet! Will you be the first?
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.geen_pepernoo: (The pepernoten themselves are still on their way: kern isn't here yet.)
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.einde.ai: %s points. Lin: 'Hm. Maybe it was set to defrost.'
%s points. Lin: 'The tastiest oliebollen in the Guhmension. From an airfryer. I'm not saying anything. ...VAHOEG!'
%s points. Lin: 'See? Not a drop of oil. ...a bit pale, though.'
%s points. Lin: 'Nice and fluffy, and no churro incident in sight!'
%s points. Lin: 'Told you. The airfryer ALWAYS wins.'
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.einde.pa: %s points. Oops... more vads than ball. Better luck next year!
%s points. Perfect oliebollen. Grandma Marrie wipes away a little tear.
%s points. Well, they're... round. Roughly. Powdered sugar fixes everything.
%s points. Tasty oliebollen! Njeg, just one more then.
%s points. VAHOEG! Almost as good as Grandma Marrie's!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.kraam: Score %s: you get %s oliebollen to take along. Enjoy!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.kraam_ni: Score %s: those weren't pretty... the stall guh will eat them himself, njeg.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.nog_niet: The baking stall only opens for New Year's Eve (from 26 December). The dough still has to rise!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.uitleg: Space: scoop dough into the pan · click (or 1-4) when the underside is golden: turn it, and again: take it out!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.olie.uitleg_a: Space: dough into the basket · click (or 1-4) when the underside is golden: turn it, and again: take it out! Not a drop of oil, says Lin.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.eerste: Your very first Pepernoten Race! %s extra pepernoten, njeg!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.geen_ant: The cabinet doesn't answer. Try again in a bit.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.plaats: Place %s on the highscore board! VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.tip: Every 10 pepernoten on the roofs = 1 real pepernoot, up to %s a run.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.tip_eers: Your first run gives %s extra pepernoten!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.toetsen: A/D or arrows: change lanes · W or space: jump · S: duck · Esc: stop
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.uit.onge: That run went faster than the clock. It doesn't count, vadsje.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.race.uit.plaa: Place %s in the top 10! Space: once more.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.schaats.leen: You borrow a pair of winter skates for this lap.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.schaats.te_la: A lap doesn't take that long, vadsje: lap stopped.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.schaats.te_ve: You slid off the pond: lap stopped.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.schaats.uitle: Skating lap! Glide through the %s little gates (the sparkling one is next) and back through the first. Click the sign again to stop.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.schaats.vol: Your pockets are too full for a pair of skates.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.voorbij: The winter party is over. See you at the next party, vahoeg!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.chocol: With your very own first letter!
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.chocom: Warm inside: faster for a bit.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.kerstl: For your walls. Melts on 3 January.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.kerstm: For on your head. Melts on 3 January.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.mijter: Just like the Sint! Melts on 3 January.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.schaat: Faster over the ice. Until 3 January.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.winkel.vuurwe: Pink and gold, with a bang.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.zakje.al: You already found this little bag.
gui.guhs.guhwinter_spellen.zakje.gevonde: A hidden bag! %s pepernoten. (%s of %s found)
item.guhs.guhwinter_chocoladeletter.lore: Milk chocolate in the shape of your first letter. Bite the little feet off first, njeg.
item.guhs.guhwinter_chocomel.lore: With a dollop of whipped cream. Warm inside: a little faster for a while, and a bit better.
item.guhs.guhwinter_schaatsen.lore: On your feet or in your hand: on the ice you glide a lot faster.
